structure.unit: Provisions Applicable to Probate and Nonprobate Transfers

law.catch_line: Persons presumed dead; authority of clerk
law.text: A clerk of the circuit court has no authority to (i) admit to probate a will of a person presumed to be dead, (ii) grant administration upon the estate of a person presumed to be dead, or (iii) appoint a curator pursuant to § 64.2-2302.
